title: A work order link from another location still asks to switch
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, your current location and location B.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have a work order, work order 1, made at location B, and a link to it copied from the address bar.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • After the release is installed, open Work Orders at your current location.
custom_steps:
1. Paste the link to work order 1 into the address bar.
  2. Press Enter.
  3. Click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The link shows in the address bar.

Step 2:

  • The existing switch-location prompt asks to switch to location B, as before the release.

Step 3:

  • The prompt closes and you are on Work Orders, with its message, as before the release.
